invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list due to the use of collectors in the stream pipeline.
After filtering with .filter(Objects::nonNull), all elements in result must be non-null.
The output is one value per key, while input may have duplicate keys, so the result size can't exceed data size.
Parallelism parameter is intended as the level of parallel processing; it's expected to be greater than zero.
If the input data is empty, the result list should also be empty.
